text: A friend you hired is underperforming, and the team is starting to resent carrying them.

options.text: Have the hard conversation now, even if it costs the friendship
Give them more time and support before saying anything
Quietly move them to a role where they'll do less harm

text: You lent money to a relative who now clearly can't repay it.

options.text: Forgive the debt and say so
Ask for repayment on a gentler schedule
Say nothing and let it go silently

text: Someone insults you publicly, unfairly.

options.text: Say nothing now and address it privately later

text: You're praised for an achievement that was mostly a colleague's work.

options.text: Share the credit later when there's a natural chance
Accept it — the colleague will get their turn

text: You're exhausted, and a duty you agreed to is due tomorrow. Doing it well will cost the sleep you need.

options.text: Do it, and do it well, tonight
Ask for an extension and rest
Do a passable version and rest

text: A rule at work is unjust to a group you're not part of. Objecting will cost you standing.

options.text: Work quietly to change it from inside
Leave it to those affected to raise

text: You can take a higher-paying role doing work you find empty, or stay in modest work you find meaningful.

options.text: Take the money for a set period, with a plan to return

text: A friend asks your honest opinion of a project you think will fail.

options.text: Encourage them and keep your doubts to yourself
Ask questions that let them find the weaknesses themselves

text: Someone who harmed you badly is now in trouble, and you could easily make it worse for them.

options.text: Do nothing to them either way
Let consequences fall on them; don't intervene

text: A friend is grieving and wants you to say their loss will make sense someday. You don't believe it will.

options.text: Say it anyway, to comfort them
Stay with them without saying it
Gently say what you honestly believe

text: You can lead a high-profile effort you're not sure you're ready for.

options.text: Accept and learn on the job
Accept, but insist on an experienced partner

text: In a group, people are mocking someone who isn't present.
You can finish a task quickly to an acceptable standard, or slowly to a standard only you would notice.

options.text: Take the time to do it excellently
Do it quickly now and improve it later if it matters

text: An aging parent wants to keep living alone; you believe it's no longer safe.

options.text: Negotiate a middle path with more support

text: A small lie would spare someone's feelings and harm no one you can see.

options.text: Find something true and kind to say instead

text: You can leave a secure position to pursue something you believe in, with a real chance of failure.

options.text: Stay and pursue it on the side

text: As a leader, you must cut one of two people. One is more skilled; the other has served loyally for years.

options.text: Look for any alternative before cutting either

text: Your work is going well, but it's slowly damaging your health.

options.text: Keep going while it's going well
Set a firm end date and keep going until then

text: Someone apologizes for a serious wrong, but you doubt they've changed.

options.text: Forgive them but keep your distance
Withhold forgiveness until they show change

text: You're offered public recognition that would require you to simplify your views into slogans.

options.text: Accept only on terms that let you speak with nuance

text: Someone you're mentoring makes a mistake you could prevent; letting it happen would teach them more.

options.text: Let it happen and help them learn from it
Warn them once and let them decide

text: Your neighborhood needs a volunteer for a thankless job that will take hours every week.

options.text: Leave it to those with more time

text: You promised to attend an event, and something far more valuable to you has come up.

options.text: Ask to be released from it

text: After a serious setback, people urge you to quit while you can still save face.
You own something valuable that someone else needs far more than you do.

options.text: Sell it and give part of the proceeds

text: Publishing an uncomfortable truth would help many strangers but hurt someone close to you.

options.text: Publish only after telling the person close to you first

text: You're offered a pleasure you know you'll regret tomorrow but enjoy tonight.

options.text: Accept a smaller version of it

text: Two people you respect ask you to take sides in their dispute.

options.text: Take the side you think is right
Try to help them resolve it directly

text: Your days are full of urgent but unimportant tasks, and the important work keeps slipping.

options.text: Protect time for the important work, letting some urgent things fail
Clear the urgent things first, then the important work
Delegate or drop the urgent tasks wherever possible

text: You receive harsh criticism that is partly unfair and partly true.

options.text: Thank them and act on the true part
Defend yourself against the unfair part

text: A process you depend on is slow, and you could force it faster at some cost to others.

options.text: Push politely and accept the outcome

text: Everyone around you is working through the holiday; you planned to rest.
You catch someone in a small theft committed out of real need.

options.text: Confront them privately and help them

text: You can spend your next years building something that outlasts you, or enjoying the life you've already built.

options.text: Mostly enjoy, but leave one lasting thing

text: You are ordered to do something legal that you believe is wrong.
A rival succeeds in something you wanted, partly through luck.
A stranger asks for help that would be inconvenient and carries a small risk.

options.text: Point them to someone better placed to help

text: You can make an important decision now with the information you have, or delay to learn more while the chance may pass.

options.text: Make a small, reversible move now and learn as you go

text: You have the skill to help in an emergency, but helping exposes you to real danger.

options.text: Help in the safest way available, even if less effective

text: You realize a deeply held belief of yours was mistaken, and admitting it will unsettle people who rely on you.

options.text: Keep the belief publicly until a better time
